purpose: Sampling-only ablation of the corrected Chrono-A1 Conv1D-TemporalGCN baseline.

hypotheses.null: Hierarchical scenario-balanced sampling does not materially improve normal-run false-positive robustness relative to Chrono-A1 when all other variables are frozen.
hypotheses.alternative: Hierarchical scenario-balanced sampling reduces normal-run macro and worst-run false-positive rates without materially degrading attack recall, weak-S20 performance, or attacker localization.

sampler_definition.placement_handling: Balance exact active-core and attacker placements primarily through run-uniform selection unless the B1.1 audit demonstrates the need for another explicit hierarchy level.
sampler_definition.replacement_policy: To be frozen after B1.1 distribution audit.
sampler_definition.samples_per_epoch: To be frozen after B1.1 distribution audit; default candidate is the original Chrono-A1 training-sample count.
sampler_definition.temporal_separation: To be frozen after inspecting window length and end_epoch spacing; minibatches should avoid adjacent highly overlapping windows from the same run.

verdict_rules.retain: Both primary FPR improvements pass and all safeguards pass.
verdict_rules.promising_but_inconclusive: FPR improves materially but one safeguard narrowly fails, or seed-7 evidence needs replication.
verdict_rules.reject: Normal FPR does not improve materially, or improvements require unacceptable losses in attack/S20 recall or localization.

evaluation_protocol.secondary_operating_point: Select graph and node thresholds independently from B1 validation predictions, freeze them, then transfer to B1 test.
evaluation_protocol.test_set_role: Diagnostic confirmation only; never used to tune B1.
